label: Exact food match
minimum_conditions: Same species/type, edible part, raw/cooked state, processing, fortification, fat/salt status and basis.
evidence_ceiling: B unless Iranian laboratory grade A exists
required_documentation: Source record ID, release, complete description, differences = none

label: Recipe calculation / controlled composite
minimum_conditions: All ingredients matched; weighed recipe; edible portions; cooked yield; retention factors; reproducible equations.
required_documentation: Recipe version, ingredient source IDs, raw weights, yield, retention set

label: Documented close match
minimum_conditions: Minor cultivar/brand/geography difference; no material state or processing difference; impact assessed.

label: Weak substitute
minimum_conditions: Food group similarity but important identity, processing or composition differences remain.
required_documentation: Explicit uncertainty and reason no better match exists
